name: B10-0424/2026 – Recital C – Am 22
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: C.whereas Islam, as a religion, is not inherently political or hostile, and the overwhelming majority of those who observe Islam as a religion reject violence against civilians in the name of Islam; whereas political Islamism must not be presented as synonymous with, or representative of, Islam as such but, rather, understood as a distinct political phenomenon characterised by the political instrumentalisation of a particular interpretation of Islam; whereas criticism of a political ideology must not be equated with an attack on a religion;
